data.title: Music Night Under the Stars — a recap
data.excerpt: On one weekend night in September, the slope of Phou Khao Khouay where Materm’s treehouses sit turned into an impromptu music stage. Three local bands took turns playing. A familiar place became a place to listen.
data.label: Music Night
